Fair.

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##

##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Fair. Small risk of isolated mist and fog patches developing in places overnight into Friday.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, but poor or very poor in any mist and fog patches.
